reason: The README describes a Claude Code and Codex plugin whose primary purpose is to orchestrate a constrained, reviewable UI design pipeline covering baseline discovery, reference intake, UX specification, planning, component selection, craft checks, previews, evidence capture, and acceptance recirculation.

summaries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的 UI 设计工作流编排插件，用于生成设计规范、执行审查并通过可选的浏览器预览和运行时证据完成验收闭环。
summaries.en: A Claude Code and Codex plugin that orchestrates a constrained UI design workflow for producing specifications, running reviews, and optionally collecting browser previews and runtime evidence for acceptance.

capabilities: orchestrates UI design specification and review workflows
generates project design and decision artifacts under .scratch/<run>/
registers screenshots and related metadata without performing image understanding
optionally launches browser previews through an MCP adapter
optionally captures runtime evidence with Playwright and Chromium
